summary: Need a global condition 'last tracked target is damaged (hp < maxHp) after the hit' for a self-targeted segment. Native 7791: Damage [AddForDamaged 10] -> Enrage@Self [AddForKill] -> CountSet@FromTarget [AddForDamaged 100] -> Enrage@Self (counter). targetHpDamaged on an allySelf segment tests the caster, so the post-hit 'Enrage if the enemy is damaged' branch cannot be expressed; kill branch and +10 are already in the curated def.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6587'}) -> E11 takes 14 (hp 900->896) but caster gets no Rage

summary: status.ts applyStatus: Blessed blocks every later status incl. positive ones, so native CauseSpecificStatusEffectConditional Blessed then Enchanted on Self (EN 'Bless and Enchant myself') only leaves Blessed. Official page says Blessed gives immunity to 'all status effects'; whether positive statuses from the same spell are blocked needs a source ruling (curated def already follows native order).

Native 7670: CountSet@FromTarget [AddForMoreLifeOnTarget 20] -> GiveSouls@Self 10 (+counter) -> Damage [MultiplyForMoreLifeOnTarget 3]: the Life comparison happens before the hit. targetStatBeatsCaster reads castTracking.lastTarget, which is unset before the first targeted segment, so souls must follow the damage and compare the post-hit Life (wrong when target Life exceeds caster Life by less than the damage). Needs a chosen-target (pre-hit) variant of targetStatBeatsCaster, or a snapshot at cast start.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6483', caster:{hp:890}}) -> E11 900 > 890 before the hit (x3 damage 39 -> hp 871 < 890), souls +10 only instead of +30
